evals.expected_output: Confirms every Blocked by issue is merged and nobody holds the ticket; names the model and effort from ~/.claude/pstack-models.md "Difficulty tiers" and why; fills references/brief.md from the ticket with each exit criterion saying how it is measured; makes the tree with thoven-worktree create; launches one Agent call (subagent_type general-purpose) whose prompt is the filled brief naming both trees; runs workspace update THV-862 started.

evals.expected_output: Sends the builder back with "Measure every exit criterion." for criterion 3 before review; then pushes, opens the PR (workspace update THV-862 pr <n>) and follows references/review.md: main's checks, one review-change, one fix round; leaves Done to Linear after the merge; files the StudentSelect empty state as a sub-issue that is Done before the ticket closes.
